# Hello World — Dioxus Template

> A minimal Dioxus + Rust + WebAssembly web-application template.
> Copy this app and replace the placeholder content to build your own SPA.

This is a starter template, not a production application.

## Stack

- Language: Rust
- UI framework: Dioxus (https://dioxuslabs.com/)
- Target: WebAssembly (WASM)
- Build tool: dx (Dioxus CLI)

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/Adafede/dioxus/tree/main/apps/hello-world
- Licence: AGPL-3.0-only

## Usage

1. Copy the app: `cp -r apps/hello-world apps/my-new-app`
2. Edit `Cargo.toml` and `Dioxus.toml` (change `name`)
3. Add the new app to workspace members in the root `Cargo.toml`
4. Run: `dx serve --package my-new-app`
